title: Commercial Agreement Triage & Redline Workflow
description: Standardized review workflow for incoming vendor agreements, NDAs, and SaaS contracts against enterprise risk thresholds.

steps.title: Agreement Classification & NDA Triage
steps.objective: Identify contract structure and classify confidentiality restrictions.
steps.prompt_guidance: Triage NDA terms into GREEN, YELLOW, or RED risk buckets.
steps.expected_output: NDA risk scorecard with key flags.
steps.verification_gate: Ensure no post-termination non-compete clauses violate Section 27 ICA.

steps.title: Substantive MSA & SLA Audit
steps.objective: Audit liability caps, indemnification, warranty disclaimers, and payment terms.
steps.prompt_guidance: Audit liability cap multiplier and benchmark service levels.
steps.expected_output: Clause-by-clause contract matrix with fallback language.
steps.verification_gate: Ensure liability cap carve-outs include gross negligence and data breach.

steps.title: Data Privacy & Security Addendum Review
steps.objective: Align data processing addendum with Indian data protection legislation.
steps.prompt_guidance: Review data breach notification windows and sub-processor provisions.
steps.verification_gate: Verify cross-border transfer compliance under DPDP Act 2023.

steps.title: Executive Summary & Negotiation Markup
steps.objective: Produce clean redlined markup and executive summary for business stakeholders.
steps.prompt_guidance: Generate plain-language negotiation summary highlighting deal-breaker points.
steps.expected_output: Executive summary memorandum and redline package.
steps.verification_gate: Business stakeholder sign-off on accepted commercial risks.
